When a host supplies the optional `vscode.modelConfiguration` read-only session report, entries are keyed by the exact advertised chat URI. The content provider maps only that chat's model identifiers to editor identifiers and exposes the report through `IChatSession.modelConfigurationState` and `IChatModel.modelConfigurationState`. The shared chat input uses its defaults, read-only options, and applied values without overwriting personal preferences or another chat's state. Absence or removal clears the scoped projection; runtime ownership and enforcement do not move into the client. Host-advertised `vscode.modelConfiguration.defaults` model metadata opts model options into scalar source tracking so an untouched displayed default is not mistaken for an explicit selection when it crosses AHP.

+Custom agents can advertise an ordered `vscode.models` list, `vscode.reasoningEffort`, and `vscode.modelPolicy` (`preferred` or `required`) in their optional customization metadata. Selecting an agent applies its available model and supported effort to that chat without changing last-used preferences. The model picker annotates authored models; a manual choice updates the chat and last-used preference, not `chat.defaultModel`. A required list filters ordinary and comparison choices, excludes synthetic Auto fallback, and blocks submission if no authored model is available. Model discovery can make a blocked draft sendable without discarding its text. Effort remains editable. Missing policy metadata retains preferred behavior; these client-side selection checks do not replace runtime enforcement.

The desktop-only Dev Container target is local draft state rather than host-declared session configuration. Before the first request, the local provider starts or reuses the container Agent Host, trusts the mapped workspace only after the source folder passes trust, and replaces the local draft with an equivalent draft owned by the dynamic remote provider. Compatible configuration, model, and custom-agent selections transfer to the replacement.
